thread.title: Wall Street Sees Upbeat Session After Strong Black Friday Sales

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Sees Upbeat Session After Strong Black Friday Sales
text:
Shutterstock photo US stocks were set for an upbeat session Monday following a strong Black Friday holiday sales event, with a record $6.22 billion in online sales.
Oil prices nudged higher with global benchmark Brent crude up 2.18%, and US West Texas Intermediate crude up 1.8% recently as the commodity recovered from a nearly 8% plunge in the previous session.
Data released at 8:30 am showed the Chicago Fed National Activity index came at 0.24 in October, above the 0.20 consensus estimate for the month and 0.17 in previous month, according to data compiled by Econoday.
At 10 am, forecasters see the general activity index based on the Dallas Fed Manufacturing Survey coming in at 28.6 in November as compared with 29.4 in October.
In equities, shares of Edge Therapeutics ( EDGE ) were 34.3% higher pre-bell after the biotech company agreed to merge with private-held PDS Biotechnology.
